title: Otanes son of Hystaspes
summary: Raleigh names Otanes son of Hystaspes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Otanes, whom Reineccius giues as a sonne of Hystaspes, with Darius, Artabanus, Artaphernes, and Atarnes. He is not Otanes of the seuen Princes, and not Otanes the sonne of Sysamnes. The one-word title would fold onto otanes, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
